text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":1,"unit":"hour","kind":"count","span":"one hour ahead of the time in Japan"},{"id":"q2","value":12,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"12:55 am (hour part)"}],"plan":[{"op":"sub","args":["q2","q1"],"out":"s1","note":"Philippines hour minus the 1-hour difference gives the corresponding hour in Japan (before adjusting for possibly crossing into the previous day)"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"the day and time it was in Japan when Luz called"},"dismissed":[{"value":55,"reason":"the minutes are unaffected by the 1-hour zone shift, so this number isn't used in the hour calculation"},{"value":25,"reason":"the calendar day shifts qualitatively (to December 24) when crossing midnight backward; it isn't used in a numeric operation here"},{"value":2014,"reason":"the year doesn't factor into the hour/day shift caused by the 1-hour time difference"}]}
